title: Amy's Questions
text: My friend Amy asked me many questions today. She asked, "What is your favorite food?" I said pizza. She asked, "How often do you eat pizza?" I usually eat it on weekends, but I seldom eat it on school days. Then she asked, "When is your birthday, and where do you want to go?" I told her my birthday is in May, and I want to go to the zoo. She asked why I like the zoo, and I said I always love animals. Finally, she asked whose idea it was to visit, and I said it was my idea. I never get tired of talking about animals!
